text:
sam: hi support — customer reported that applying a second promo code replaced their existing credit instead of stacking. account id acct_93b2, originally had RED10 applied (10% credit), then they added TRIAL50 via dashboard and balance dropped to only TRIAL50 credits. they expected them to stack.
elaine: thanks — can you paste exact steps / timestamps? was the second code applied via API or UI?
sam: via UI. steps: 1) applied RED10 in promo box on billing page (shows applied). 2) used promo box again, entered TRIAL50, clicked apply. UI toast: "Promo applied". Billing history shows only TRIAL50 line and RED10 gone.
sam: repro on my dev account: 
```
POST /v1/accounts/acct_93b2/promos/apply
{ "code": "RED10" }
POST /v1/accounts/acct_93b2/promos/apply
{ "code": "TRIAL50" }
```
sam: after second apply, GET /v1/accounts/acct_93b2/credits returns only cr_02.
marco: hmm, that sounds like the apply path is doing an overwrite when the incoming promo sets credit_amount rather than adding. possibly intended for one-off grants but not for stackable promos.
elaine: did the promo definitions indicate stackable=true? can you share codes metadata (we can obfuscate ids)?
sam: RED10 meta (from admin UI): {type: "percent", stackable: true, expires: "2026-06-01"}
sam: TRIAL50 meta: {type: "fixed", stackable: false, expires: "2026-04-01"}
june: quick note — non-stackable promos should not remove existing credits, they should just refuse if policy conflicts. current behavior seems to delete and replace.
billing-bot: Event: promo_apply | account: acct_93b2 | code: TRIAL50 | result: applied | prior_credits_removed: 1
elaine: assigning to eng-oncall to triage whether backend.applyPromo is doing upsert(delete) vs attach. @eng-oncall can you take a look?
eng-oncall: looking. initial hypothesis: promo apply handler uses a single credits array slot per account unless promo.stackable=true. but admin UI allows marking stackable=false to prevent stacking — however we shouldn't delete existing credits, only block or queue. collecting logs.
marco: repro steps and curl? sam, can you include response bodies? also what's billing ledger show?
sam: ledger excerpt: 
- 2026-03-16T14:12:03Z: credit_add cr_01 RED10 +$0.00 (10% off)
- 2026-03-16T14:21:10Z: credit_apply cr_02 TRIAL50 +$50.00
- 2026-03-16T14:21:10Z: credit_remove cr_01 (system)
sam: curl I used to repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_93b2/promos/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \
  -d '{"code":"TRIAL50"}'
```
eng-oncall: saw the same sequence in logs from 2026-03-16T14:21:10Z. stackable=false promos trigger a policy that calls remove_conflicting_credits(account, promo) which currently unconditionally removes conflicting credits. that's a bug — should either reject apply or mark schedule to expire prior credits on next invoice.
elaine: impact? how many customers hit this?
eng-oncall: so far 3 reported incidents this week. all have non-stackable second codes.
marco: mitigation options: 1) revert handler to reject apply when conflicts detected (safe), 2) patch to keep prior credits and mark them retained but not combinable (complex), 3) one-off credit restore for affected accounts + longer-term policy fix.
june: customer-facing resolution: restore RED10 credit for acct_93b2 and offer apology + one-week free trial extension.
elaine: agreed. sam can you verify restore request with billing ops ticket and include affected account details?
sam: opened BILL-4891 with restore request and notes. billing ops pinged me back: will apply manual credit restore today and issue 1-week extension.
eng-oncall: patch plan: will change remove_conflicting_credits to reject if conflicting credits present and user attempted via UI; API will return 409 with explanation and include conflict details. I'll open PR and request expedited review.
marco: please include clear error code (PROMO_CONFLICT) so SDKs can surface friendly message.
eng-oncall: noted. will target hotfix 2026-03-17 09:00 PT.
elaine: thanks team. sam — please confirm once billing ops completes restore so we can update the customer.
sam: will do. customer notified that we're investigating. they asked for ETA — sent provisional ETA for fix + manual restore later today. :thumbsup:
marco: for follow-up, add a unit test for applyPromo that covers (stackable=false) + existing credits to assert 409. also add an integration test for dashboard flow so UI shows conflict dialog instead of "Promo applied".
eng-oncall: will include tests in PR.
elaine: closing loop: once BILL-4891 done and PR merged, we should update docs page about "promo stacking rules" to clarify behavior.
sam: confirmed restore completed at 2026-03-16T18:02:21Z per billing ops. customer replied satisfied. thanks everyone. :tada:
